# Region Syddanmark

Region Syddanmark is one of Denmark's five administrative health regions and a recurring subject in the annual reports of ADHD-DATABASEN, the national quality-monitoring database for ADHD assessment and treatment of children, young people, and (from 2024) adults [^src1][^src8]. Across the 2023 and 2024 reports, the region is repeatedly singled out — sometimes for strong results, sometimes for sharp declines — making it one of the more closely tracked regions in the dataset.

In the 2023 report (covering 01.04.2023–31.03.2024), Region Syddanmark stood out for having previously come close to meeting the national performance standard of 90% on several indicators, but for showing a significant drop in performance. The report explicitly attributes this decline to "a large drop at departments in Esbjerg and Vejle," likely caused by reduced medical staffing at those units [^src1]. On indicator 2a (clinical environmental observation for children under 6), the region posted the highest rate nationally at 91% [^src2]. On indicator 2b (diagnostic interview or environmental observation for 6–17 year-olds), however, the region's compliance fell from 90% to 77%; the report notes that the region reported "exactly the same number" of indicator-fulfilling service codes as the year before, meaning the drop in percentage was driven by a rise in the total number of assessment cases rather than a decline in actual service delivery [^src3].

Elsewhere in the 2023 report the region's performance was markedly weaker. It recorded the lowest regional result nationally on indicator 3 (diagnostic conferences), at just 10% (112 of 1,171 cases) — the low end of a national range stretching to 34% in Region Nordjylland [^src4]. On indicator 4 (coordinating network meetings), it reached 24% (205 of 841 cases) [^src4], and on indicator 6 it recorded the lowest regional share at 7%, versus a high of 50% in Region Midtjylland [^src5]. The region also reported 58 disproved ADHD assessment cases in the period [^src7], and 725 of 1,171 assessment cases (62%) with somatic examination completed [^src21]. On educational outcomes, 54% of young people in the region's ADHD assessment population passed their lower-secondary school exit exam before turning 17, versus 66% in the treatment population [^src20]. Region Syddanmark operates the Aabenraa Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Outpatient Clinic ("Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium"), which falls under the region's administration [^src7]. When invited to comment on the 2023 annual report, the region stated it had no comments [^src7].

The 2024 report (covering 01.04.2024–31.03.2025) shows a mixed but generally declining picture. Nationally, the report notes regional progress in Hovedstaden, Syddanmark, Nordjylland, and especially Midtjylland [^src8]. Region Syddanmark posted the highest rate on indicator 2a at 88% — a point lower than the year before but still ahead of Region Midtjylland's 86% — and 70% on indicator 2b, again the national high but part of a "continuing downward trend" from 77% the previous year [^src9][^src10]. Regional variation on indicator 2b that year ranged from 32% in Region Sjælland to 70% in Syddanmark [^src10]. On indicator 3, the region improved from 16% to 26% [^src10]. Region Syddanmark and Region Hovedstaden were jointly identified as the regions with the most network meetings held within the required deadline, though both remained far from the 90% development target [^src11]. The region again recorded the lowest share nationally on indicator 5 (psychoeducation), at 9%, unchanged in rank from the prior year [^src12], while reaching 72% on indicator 6 (medication compliance) [^src12]. On indicator 8 (psychoeducation for adults), the region reported very low uptake, with psychotherapy assessed as relevant for fewer than three patients [^src15]. On indicator 9 (education outcomes, second measure), the region placed second-lowest nationally at 67% [^src17]. Volume data for 2024/25 show 1,074 ADHD assessment cases, 890 child/youth treatment cases, and 1,110 adult treatment cases attributed to the region [^src18], along with 67 assessment cases closed within 90 days due to a disproved suspicion [^src18]. As in the prior year, the region reported no comments on the annual report [^src19].

Region Syddanmark reports its results to [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]] [^src11][^src13], and its performance is consistently compared against the other four Danish regions — [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] — across the database's indicator system, including [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]], [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]], [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]], and [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]].

## Claims

**Causal analysis**
- Faldet i Region Syddanmark skyldes et stort fald på afdelinger i Esbjerg og Vejle formentlig betinget af færre lægekræfter her [^src1]

**Performance-metric**
- Region Syddanmark opfylder standarden for klinisk miljøobservation med 91 % compliance [^src1]
- Region Midtjylland ligger højst på 50 % mens Region Syddanmark ligger lavest (7 %) [^src1]

**Performance**
- Region Syddanmark har 77 % andel på indikator 2b (864 / 1.118) [^src1]
- Region Syddanmark opnåede 77 % opfyldelse af Indikator 2b [^src1]
- Region Syddanmark opnåede 10 % opfyldelse af Indikator 3 i perioden 01.04.2023-31.03.2024 (112 / 1.171) [^src3]
- Region Syddanmark opnåede 88% for Indikator 2a [^src8]
- Den højeste målopfyldelse for indikator 2a ses i Syddanmark (88 %) – der dog ligger et procentpoint lavere end året forinden – tæt efterfulgt af Midtjylland (86 %) [^src1]
- Region Syddanmark opnåede 70 % opfyldelse af indikator 2b [^src1]
- Region Hovedstaden og Region Syddanmark er de regioner der er registret med flest netværksmøder indenfor tidsfristen, men stadig langt fra udviklingsmålet på 90% [^src1]
- Syddanmark ligger, ligesom i 2023/24, lavest med en andel på 9% [^src1]
- Region Syddanmark opnåede 72 % målopfyldelse for Indikator 6 [^src2]

**Analysis**
- Region Syddanmark, der sidste år levede op til standarden, har indberettet nøjagtigt samme antal indikatoropfyldende ydelseskoder i år, så tilbagegangen fra 90 % til 77 % målopfyldelse skyldes stigning i antal udredningsforløb [^src1]

**Regional-variation**
- Regionsresultaterne for indikator 3 varierer fra 10 % (Region Syddanmark) til 34 % (Region Nordjylland) [^src1]
- Der ses betydelig regional variation på Indikator 2b fra 32 % i Sjælland til 70 % i Syddanmark[^src1]

**Regional-performance**
- Region Syddanmark havde 24 % opfyldelse af indikator 4 (95% CI: 22-27) med 205 forløb ud af 841 [^src1]
- Syddanmark opnåede en stigning på Indikator 3 fra 16 % i 2023/24 til 26 % i 2024/25[^src1]
- Næstlavest lå Syddanmark på 67 % [^src1]

**Statistical**
- Region Syddanmark havde 58 afkræftede ADHD-udredningsforløb i perioden 01.04.2023-31.03.2024 [^src1]
- Syddanmark havde 54 % andel af unge i ADHD-udredningspopulation, der bestod folkeskolens afgangseksamen inden fyldt 17 år i 2023 [^src1]
- Syddanmark havde 66 % andel af unge i ADHD-behandlingspopulation, der bestod folkeskolens afgangseksamen inden fyldt 17 år i 2023 [^src1]

**Epidemiological**
- I Syddanmark var psykoterapi vurderet relevant hos mindre end tre patienter i alt [^src1]
- Region Hovedstaden havde 2.183 ADHD-udredningsforløb, Region Sjælland 733, Region Syddanmark 1.074, Region Midtjylland 873 og Region Nordjylland 416 i perioden 1. april 2024 - 31. marts 2025 [^src1]
- Region Hovedstaden havde 1.905 ADHD-behandlingsforløb blandt børn og unge, Region Sjælland 498, Region Syddanmark 890, Region Midtjylland 1.107 og Region Nordjylland 555 i perioden 1. april 2024 - 31. marts 2025 [^src2]
- Region Hovedstaden havde 311 ADHD-behandlingsforløb blandt voksne, Region Sjælland 114, Region Syddanmark 1.110, Region Midtjylland 940 og Region Nordjylland 163 i perioden 1. april 2024 - 31. marts 2025 [^src3]

**Operational**
- Region Syddanmark havde 67 ADHD-udredningsforløb afsluttet indenfor 90 dage pga. mistanke afkræftet i perioden 1. april 2024 - 31. marts 2025 [^src4]

**Procedural**
- Region Syddanmark har meldt tilbage, at der ingen kommentarer er til årsrapporten [^src1]

**Clinical-outcome**
- Syddanmark-regionen rapporterer 725 / 1.171 forløb med somatisk udredning (62%, 95% CI: 59-65) [^src1]
